Subject: Hosted API pricing — monthly token range & peak TPS clarification

Hi Sanjay / Asha —

Great to speak earlier. As promised, quick recap and a couple questions so we can put together a hosted API pilot proposal and a ballpark $/1M token estimate: 

1) Expected monthly token volume (production steady state): you mentioned a range while the product team pads the pipeline. Can you confirm the most likely steady-state monthly tokens vs a 90-day ramp?
2) Peak concurrency / TPS: you called out spikes during checkout and personalization bursts. What peak TPS should we size for (sustained 1–5min windows vs instantaneous spikes)?
3) Budget target: any target $/1M tokens or monthly budget we should keep in mind for procurement?
4) Pilot length & success criteria: confirm 30 vs 90-day pilot and the three KPIs we agreed on (latency < 300ms p50, inference accuracy on sample prompts, and cost per 1M tokens).

I've attached the traffic snapshot you shared in the call (for reference) and will follow up with a draft pricing sketch once we have the numbers. cc'ing Marissa to run arithmetic on unit economics.

Next steps: if you can reply with the numbers below I’ll turn around a hosted API pilot proposal by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Jordan

Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — monthly token range & peak TPS clarification

Thanks Jordan — great call. Quick answers inline: 

- Monthly tokens (steady state): we expect ~100M tokens/month once the integration is complete (we're comfortable with a 60–90 day ramp).
- Ramp profile: month 1 = 20–30M, month 2 = 60–80M, month 3+ = 100M typical.
- Peak TPS: observed peaks up to ~55 TPS during checkout surge events (these are ~2–3 minute windows). Sustained periods more like 18–25 TPS. Please size for 60 TPS headroom.
- Budget target: our finance team is looking to keep the hosted inference spend ~ $35k–$60k/month for the initial contract year. If you can show $/1M that maps into that band, it’s promising.
- Pilot: prefer a 60-day pilot with an opt-in to a 12-month commit if we meet latency and cost KPIs.

Also attaching the CSV export of recent traffic patterns (same file as the one Jordan has). Let me know if you need sample prompts or evals — we can share a small labeled set.

—Sanjay
Head of Product | Merchant Labs
[sanjay@merchantlabs.com]

Appreciate the details, Sanjay — this is exactly what we needed. Quick calibration on the numbers and proposed next steps: 

- Confirmed steady-state: 100M tokens/month after a ~90-day ramp (we'll model 20/70/100 for months 1/2/3+).
- Capacity planning: we'll propose a config that supports sustained 25 TPS and handles 60 TPS for 3-minute surge windows (autoscaling + burst headroom).
- Budget mapping: given your $35k–$60k/month target, Marissa & Neha will run unit-econ scenarios. To give you a quick lens, if we price at $700 / 1M tokens it would imply ~$70k/month on 100M tokens — so we need to explore tiered slabs and a committed discount to hit the upper end of your band.

Action items: - Marissa: can you put together 2 pricing scenarios (conservative + committed) and a sample SLA for a 60-day pilot? Include explicit unit economics (per-1M, projected monthly $) and peak TPS sizing notes.
- Neha: can you run a short simulation on how autoscaling/burst affects effective $/1M at the traffic shape Sanjay shared?
- Sanjay / Asha: please confirm whether you can provide the small labeled eval set (helps with quality regressions during pilot).

I'll draft a one-page pilot proposal and send it to you by EOD tomorrow with both pricing scenarios attached.

Thanks —
Jordan
